    function startCountdown() {
        if (countdownInterval) clearInterval(countdownInterval);
        countdownInterval = setInterval(() => {
            if (!nextRefreshTime) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            const remaining = nextRefreshTime - now;

            if (remaining <= 0) {
                const timeSinceLastFetch = now - lastFetchedAt;
                if (timeSinceLastFetch < 30000) {
                    if (countdownEl) countdownEl.textContent = 'Actualizando...';
                    return; 
                }

                delete memCache[currentPeriod];
                loadData(currentPeriod);
                return;
            }
            const totalSeconds = Math.floor(remaining / 1000);
            const m = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);
            const s = totalSeconds % 60;
            if (countdownEl) countdownEl.textContent = `Faltan ${m}m ${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}s`;
        }, 1000);
    }

    async function loadData(period, forceRefresh = false) {
        if (pendingPeriod === period) return;
        const version = ++requestVersion;
        pendingPeriod = null;

        const cached = memCache[period];
        if (cached && !forceRefresh && (Date.now() < cached.nextRefreshAt)) {
            skeleton.classList.add('hidden');
            if (itemsEl.dataset.renderedPeriod !== period) {
                renderList(cached.data, period);
            }
            itemsEl.classList.remove('hidden');
            emptyEl.classList.toggle('hidden', cached.data.length > 0);
            nextRefreshTime = cached.nextRefreshAt;
            startCountdown();
            return;
        }

        pendingPeriod = period;
        lastFetchedAt = Date.now();
        skeleton.classList.remove('hidden');
        itemsEl.classList.add('hidden');
        emptyEl.classList.add('hidden');

            const res  = await fetch(`/api/mangas/top-views?period=${period}&limit=30`);

            const serverCachedAt = json.cachedAt ?? Date.now();

            memCache[period] = { data, ts: serverCachedAt, nextRefreshAt };
            if (version !== requestVersion) return;
            skeleton.classList.add('hidden');
            currentPeriod = period;
            nextRefreshTime = nextRefreshAt;
            startCountdown();

            if (!data.length) { 
                itemsEl.dataset.renderedPeriod = '';
                emptyEl.classList.remove('hidden'); 
                return; 
            }
            renderList(data, period);
            itemsEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        } catch (e) {
            if (version !== requestVersion) return;
            skeleton.classList.add('hidden');
            emptyEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        } finally {
            if (version === requestVersion) pendingPeriod = null;

    };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
        const modal = document.getElementById('preference-modal');
        const backdrop = document.getElementById('preference-backdrop');
        const panel = document.getElementById('preference-panel');
        const saveBtn = document.getElementById('save-preference');
        const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.preference-btn');
        const typeCheckboxes = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="contentTypes"]');
        const demoCheckboxes = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="demographics"]');
        
        // Check if user has already set preference in localStorage
        const hasSeen = localStorage.getItem('preference-seen');
        const currentPref = localStorage.getItem('content-preference');
        const currentTypes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('content-types') || '["manga","manhwa","manhua","novela","one_shot"]');
        const currentDemos = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('content-demographics') || '["shounen","seinen","shoujo","josei","none"]');

        // Mantener el HTML idéntico para que Cloudflare pueda compartirlo.
        let user = null;
        const userReady = (async () => {
          try {
            window.__USER_FETCH__ = window.__USER_FETCH__ || fetch('/api/user/me').then(r => r.json());
            const data = await window.__USER_FETCH__;
            user = data?.user || null;
          } catch {
            user = null;
          }
        })();
        // Registrar antes de esperar la cuenta: también cubre clics con una conexión lenta.
        window.openContentPreferenceModal = showModal;
        await userReady;
        
        let selectedValue = currentPref || 'sfw'; // Default to sfw if null, or maybe null? Let's default to sfw for UI state if generic.
        // Actually, if null, no button is selected.

        // Sync from DB
        if (user) {
            if (user.contentPreference) {
                 localStorage.setItem('content-preference', user.contentPreference);
                 selectedValue = user.contentPreference;
            }
            if (user.contentTypes) {
                localStorage.setItem('content-types', JSON.stringify(user.contentTypes));
                // Update checkboxes
                typeCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = user.contentTypes.includes(cb.value));
            } else {
                // If not in DB (first load?), use local or default
                typeCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = currentTypes.includes(cb.value));
            }

            if (user.demographics) {
                localStorage.setItem('content-demographics', JSON.stringify(user.demographics));
                demoCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = user.demographics.includes(cb.value));
            } else {
                 demoCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = currentDemos.includes(cb.value));
            }

            if (!hasSeen) {
                localStorage.setItem('preference-seen', 'true');
            }
        } else {
            // Restore from local
            if (currentPref) selectedValue = currentPref;
            typeCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = currentTypes.includes(cb.value));
            demoCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = currentDemos.includes(cb.value));
        }
        
        // Apply UI selection
        if (selectedValue) {
            const btn = document.querySelector(`.preference-btn[data-value="${selectedValue}"]`);
            if (btn) {
                btn.classList.add('selected', 'bg-slate-800');
                btn.classList.remove('border-slate-700');
                if (selectedValue === 'sfw') btn.classList.add('border-primary');
                else btn.classList.add('border-red-500');
            }
        }

        // Auto-open Disabled by user request
        // if (!hasSeen) {
        //     showModal();
        // }

        async function showModal() {
            await userReady;
            if (!user) {
                window.openLoginModal?.();
                return;
            }
            modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                backdrop.classList.remove('opacity-0');
                panel.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4', 'scale-95');
            });
        }

        function hideModal() {
            backdrop.classList.add('opacity-0');
            panel.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4', 'scale-95');
            setTimeout(() => {
                modal.classList.add('hidden');
            }, 300);
        }

        function checkFormValidity() {
             const typesChecked = Array.from(typeCheckboxes).some(cb => cb.checked);
             const demosChecked = Array.from(demoCheckboxes).some(cb => cb.checked);
             const prefSelected = !!selectedValue;

             if (typesChecked && demosChecked && prefSelected) {
                 saveBtn.disabled = false;
                 saveBtn.classList.remove('opacity-50', 'cursor-not-allowed');
             } else {
                 saveBtn.disabled = true;
                 saveBtn.classList.add('opacity-50', 'cursor-not-allowed');
             }
        }

        // Selection Logic
        btns.forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                btns.forEach(b => {
                    b.classList.remove('selected', 'border-primary', 'border-red-500', 'bg-slate-800');
                    b.classList.add('border-slate-700');
                });
                
                const value = btn.dataset.value;
                selectedValue = value;
                
                btn.classList.add('selected', 'bg-slate-800');
                btn.classList.remove('border-slate-700');
                if (value === 'sfw') {
                    btn.classList.add('border-primary');
                } else {
                    btn.classList.add('border-red-500');
                }
                
                checkFormValidity();
            });
        });

        // Checkbox listeners
        typeCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.addEventListener('change', checkFormValidity));
        demoCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.addEventListener('change', checkFormValidity));
        checkFormValidity();

        // Close Logic
        const closeBtn = document.getElementById('close-preference-modal');
        if (closeBtn) {
            closeBtn.addEventListener('click', hideModal);
        }
        
        // Close on backdrop click
        if (modal) {
            modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (e.target === modal || e.target.closest('.flex') === e.target) { // clicking outside panel
                    // actually the structure is modal > div > div > panel
                    // The modal wrapper has padding.
                }
            });
            // simpler: clicking the backdrop div (which is absolute inset-0)
             backdrop.addEventListener('click', hideModal);
        }

        // Close on Escape key
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' && !modal.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                hideModal();
            }
        });

        // Save Logic
        saveBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
             if (!user) {
                 window.openLoginModal?.();
                 return;
             }
             if (!selectedValue) return;
             
             saveBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-icons animate-spin text-sm mr-2">refresh</span> Guardando...';
             saveBtn.disabled = true;

             const selectedTypes = Array.from(typeCheckboxes).filter(cb => cb.checked).map(cb => cb.value);
             const selectedDemos = [];
             Array.from(demoCheckboxes).forEach(cb => {
                if (cb.checked) {
                    selectedDemos.push(cb.value);
                    if (cb.value === 'shounen') selectedDemos.push('seinen');
                    if (cb.value === 'shoujo') selectedDemos.push('josei');
                    if (cb.value === 'none') {
                        // Ensure compatibility with 'ninguno' and 'kodomo' if needed, 
                        // but 'none' is handled by query mapping 'ninguno'.
                        // We also add 'kodomo' just in case.
                        selectedDemos.push('kodomo');
                    }
                }
             });

             // Save to DB
             if (user) {
                 try {
                     const res = await fetch('/api/user/preference', {
                         method: 'POST',
                         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                         body: JSON.stringify({ 
                             preference: selectedValue,
                             contentTypes: selectedTypes,
                             demographics: selectedDemos
                         })
                     });
                     
                     if (res.status === 401) {
                         user = null;
                         hideModal();
                         window.openLoginModal?.();
                         return;
                     }
                     if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to save');
                 } catch (e) {
                     console.error('Error saving preference to DB:', e);
                     saveBtn.textContent = 'Reintentar guardar preferencias';
                     checkFormValidity();
                     return;
                 }
             }

             // Reflejar localmente solo las preferencias guardadas en la cuenta.
             localStorage.setItem('content-preference', selectedValue);
             localStorage.setItem('content-types', JSON.stringify(selectedTypes));
             localStorage.setItem('content-demographics', JSON.stringify(selectedDemos));
             localStorage.setItem('preference-seen', 'true');
             window.location.reload();
        });
    });

(function () {
    const TAB_ON  = ['bg-white', 'dark:bg-slate-800', 'text-slate-900', 'dark:text-white', 'shadow-xs', 'border', 'border-slate-200/60', 'dark:border-slate-700/60'];
    const TAB_OFF = ['text-slate-500', 'dark:text-slate-400', 'hover:text-slate-900', 'dark:hover:text-white'];
    const PERIOD_LABEL = { day: 'HOY', week: 'SEMANA', month: 'MES', streak: 'RACHA' };

    const TOP3 = {
        1: { row: 'bg-amber-500/5 dark:bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-400/30 dark:border-amber-500/30', ring: 'ring-2 ring-amber-400/60', stat: 'bg-amber-500/10 dark:bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400', icon: 'text-amber-500', label: '🥇' },
        2: { row: 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/40 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700/50', ring: 'ring-2 ring-slate-300 dark:ring-slate-600', stat: 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300', icon: 'text-slate-400', label: '🥈' },
        3: { row: 'bg-amber-700/5 dark:bg-amber-700/10 border border-amber-700/20 dark:border-amber-700/30', ring: 'ring-2 ring-amber-700/50', stat: 'bg-amber-700/10 dark:bg-amber-700/20 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400', icon: 'text-amber-600', label: '🥉' },
    };

    const memCache = {};
    let loading        = false;
    let lastFetchedAt  = 0;
    let initialized    = false;
    let countdownInterval = null;
    let nextRefreshTime   = null;
    let currentPeriod     = 'day';
    let endOfPeriodMs     = 0;

    const countdownEl   = document.getElementById('top-readers-countdown-text');
    const winnerCountEl = document.getElementById('top-readers-winner-countdown-text');
    const panel         = document.getElementById('top-readers-panel');
    const overlay       = document.getElementById('top-readers-overlay');
    const skeleton      = document.getElementById('top-readers-skeleton');
    const itemsEl       = document.getElementById('top-readers-items');
    const emptyEl       = document.getElementById('top-readers-empty');
    const subtitle      = document.getElementById('top-readers-subtitle');
    const tabs          = document.querySelectorAll('.top-readers-tab');

    function formatTime(s) {
        const h = Math.floor(s / 3600), m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60);
        return h > 0 ? (m > 0 ? `${h}h ${m}m` : `${h}h`) : `${m}min`;
    }

    function updateWinnerCountdownUI() {
        if (!winnerCountEl || !endOfPeriodMs) return;
        const diff = Math.max(0, Math.floor((endOfPeriodMs - Date.now()) / 1000));
        if (diff > 0) {
            const d = Math.floor(diff / 86400), h = Math.floor((diff % 86400) / 3600),
                  m = Math.floor((diff % 3600) / 60), s = diff % 60;
            winnerCountEl.textContent = (d > 0 ? `${d}d ` : '') + `${h}h ${m}m ${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}s`;
        } else {
            winnerCountEl.textContent = 'Calculando...';
            if (endOfPeriodMs < Date.now() - 2000) calculateEndOfPeriodMX(currentPeriod);
        }
    }

    function calculateEndOfPeriodMX(period) {
        try {
            const mxDate = new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/Mexico_City' }));
            const end = new Date(mxDate);
            if (period === 'day' || period === 'streak') {
                end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
            } else if (period === 'week') {
                const d = end.getDay();
                end.setDate(end.getDate() + (d === 0 ? 0 : 7 - d));
                end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
            } else if (period === 'month') {
                end.setMonth(end.getMonth() + 1);
                end.setDate(0);
                end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
            }
            endOfPeriodMs = Date.now() + (end - mxDate);
            updateWinnerCountdownUI();
        } catch(e) { endOfPeriodMs = 0; }
    }

    function initLocalRefreshCountdown() {
        const now = new Date();
        const nextHour = new Date(now);
        nextHour.setHours(now.getHours() + 1, 0, 0, 0);
        nextRefreshTime = nextHour.getTime();
        startCountdown();
    }

    function renderList(data, period) {
        itemsEl.innerHTML = data.map(r => {
            const isTop3    = r.rank <= 3;
            const t3        = TOP3[r.rank];
            const rowCls    = isTop3 ? t3.row : 'border border-transparent hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40';
            const rankEl    = isTop3
                ? `<span class="text-base leading-none w-7 text-center shrink-0">${t3.label}</span>`
                : `<span class="w-7 text-center text-xs font-bold shrink-0 ${r.rank <= 10 ? 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300' : 'text-slate-400'}">${r.rank}</span>`;
            const ringCls   = isTop3 ? t3.ring : '';
            const isStreak  = r.isStreak || period === 'streak';
            const statIcon  = isTop3 ? t3.icon : (isStreak ? 'text-orange-500' : 'text-slate-400');
            const statVal   = isStreak ? `${r.totalSeconds} días` : formatTime(r.totalSeconds);
            const iconName  = isStreak ? 'local_fire_department' : 'schedule';
            const avatar    = r.avatar || `https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${encodeURIComponent(r.displayName)}&background=random&size=64`;
            const flag      = r.country ? `<img src="https://s1.cdnlxd.xyz/flags/${r.country.toLowerCase()}.png" alt="${r.country}" class="w-4 h-3 rounded-xs object-contain shadow-xs absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 border border-white dark:border-slate-900" />` : '';
            const frameHtml = r.equippedFrameUrl ? `<img src="${r.equippedFrameUrl}" class="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[130%] h-[130%] max-w-none pointer-events-none z-10 scale-[1.02]" alt="Marco" />` : '';
            const avatarHtml = `<img src="${avatar}" alt="${r.displayName}" class="w-full h-full object-cover shadow-xs rounded-full ${ringCls} group-hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800" loading="lazy" />`;
            const slug = r.profileSlug || r.username;
            return `<li class="flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl transition-colors duration-150 ${rowCls}">
                ${rankEl}
                <a href="/u/${slug}" data-user-id="${r.userId}" rel="nofollow" class="user-profile-trigger relative shrink-0 w-9 h-9 rounded-full block group cursor-pointer my-0.5">
                    ${frameHtml}${avatarHtml}${flag}
                </a>
                <a href="/u/${slug}" data-user-id="${r.userId}" rel="nofollow" class="user-profile-trigger cursor-pointer flex-1 min-w-0 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate hover:text-primary dark:hover:text-primary transition-colors">${r.displayName}</a>
                <span class="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold shrink-0 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg ${isTop3 ? t3.stat : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400'}">
                    <span class="material-icons-outlined text-xs ${statIcon}">${iconName}</span>
                    ${statVal}
                </span>
            </li>`;
        }).join('');
        itemsEl.dataset.renderedPeriod = period;
    }

    function startCountdown() {
        if (countdownInterval) clearInterval(countdownInterval);
        countdownInterval = setInterval(() => {
            if (!nextRefreshTime) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            const remaining = nextRefreshTime - now;
            if (remaining <= 0) {
                if (now - lastFetchedAt < 30000) {
                    if (countdownEl) countdownEl.textContent = 'Actualizando...';
                    return;
                }
                delete memCache[currentPeriod];
                loadData(currentPeriod);
                return;
            }
            const m = Math.floor(remaining / 60000);
            const s = Math.floor((remaining % 60000) / 1000);
            if (countdownEl) countdownEl.textContent = `Faltan ${m}m ${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}s`;
            updateWinnerCountdownUI();
        }, 1000);
    }

    async function loadData(period, forceRefresh = false) {
        if (loading) return;
        const cached = memCache[period];
        if (cached && !forceRefresh && Date.now() < cached.nextRefreshAt) {
            skeleton.classList.add('hidden');
            if (itemsEl.dataset.renderedPeriod !== period) renderList(cached.data, period);
            itemsEl.classList.remove('hidden');
            if (period !== currentPeriod) {
                currentPeriod   = period;
                nextRefreshTime = cached.nextRefreshAt;
                startCountdown();
            }
            return;
        }
        loading = true;
        lastFetchedAt = Date.now();
        skeleton.classList.remove('hidden');
        itemsEl.classList.add('hidden');
        emptyEl.classList.add('hidden');
        try {
            const res  = await fetch(`/api/user/top-readers?period=${period}&limit=30`);
            const json = await res.json();
            const data = json.data ?? [];
            const serverCachedAt = json.cachedAt ?? Date.now();
            const nextRefreshAt  = json.nextRefreshAt ?? (serverCachedAt + 3600000);
            memCache[period]  = { data, ts: serverCachedAt, nextRefreshAt };
            skeleton.classList.add('hidden');
            currentPeriod   = period;
            nextRefreshTime = nextRefreshAt;
            startCountdown();
            if (!data.length) { itemsEl.dataset.renderedPeriod = ''; emptyEl.classList.remove('hidden'); return; }
            renderList(data, period);
            itemsEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        } catch(e) {
            skeleton.classList.add('hidden');
            emptyEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        } finally {
            loading = false;
        }
    }

    async function prefetchSilently(period) {
        if (memCache[period] && Date.now() < memCache[period].nextRefreshAt) return;
        if (loading) return;
        loading = true;
        lastFetchedAt = Date.now();
        try {
            const res = await fetch(`/api/user/top-readers?period=${period}&limit=30`);
            if (!res.ok) return;
            const json = await res.json();
            const data = json.data ?? [];
            const serverCachedAt = json.cachedAt ?? Date.now();
            const nextRefreshAt  = json.nextRefreshAt ?? (serverCachedAt + 3600000);
            memCache[period]  = { data, ts: serverCachedAt, nextRefreshAt };
            nextRefreshTime   = nextRefreshAt;
        } catch(e) {
        } finally {
            loading = false;
        }
    }

    function setTab(period) {
        currentPeriod = period;
        calculateEndOfPeriodMX(period === 'streak' ? 'day' : period);
        const labelMap = { day: 'Cierre Diario', week: 'Cierre Semanal', month: 'Cierre Mensual', streak: 'Cierre de Rachas' };
        const labelEl  = document.getElementById('top-readers-countdown-label');
        if (labelEl) labelEl.textContent = labelMap[period] || 'Cierre Diario';
        tabs.forEach(btn => {
            const on = btn.dataset.period === period;
            TAB_ON.forEach(c  => btn.classList.toggle(c, on));
            TAB_OFF.forEach(c => btn.classList.toggle(c, !on));
        });
        if (subtitle) subtitle.textContent = `Top 30 Lectores · ${PERIOD_LABEL[period] ?? period}`;
        loadData(period);
    }

    tabs.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => setTab(btn.dataset.period)));

    window.openTopReaders = function () {
        const socialButtons = document.getElementById('global-social-buttons');
        if (socialButtons) { socialButtons.style.opacity = '0'; socialButtons.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; }
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            overlay.classList.remove('opacity-0');
            panel.classList.remove('translate-x-full');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        });
        if (!initialized) { initialized = true; setTab(currentPeriod); }
    };

    window.closeTopReaders = function () {
        overlay.classList.add('opacity-0');
        panel.classList.add('translate-x-full');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        setTimeout(() => {
            overlay.classList.add('hidden');
            const socialButtons = document.getElementById('global-social-buttons');
            if (socialButtons) { socialButtons.style.opacity = ''; socialButtons.style.pointerEvents = ''; }
        }, 300);
    };

    calculateEndOfPeriodMX('day');
    initLocalRefreshCountdown();

    const schedulePrefetch = () => prefetchSilently('day');
    if (typeof requestIdleCallback !== 'undefined') {
        requestIdleCallback(schedulePrefetch, { timeout: 3000 });
    } else {
        setTimeout(schedulePrefetch, 2000);
    }
})();

        const demoCheckboxes = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="demographics"]');
        
        // Check if user has already set preference in localStorage

                localStorage.setItem('content-types', JSON.stringify(user.contentTypes));
                // Update checkboxes
                typeCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = user.contentTypes.includes(cb.value));
            } else {
                // If not in DB (first load?), use local or default
                typeCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = currentTypes.includes(cb.value));
            }

            if (user.demographics) {
                localStorage.setItem('content-demographics', JSON.stringify(user.demographics));
                demoCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = user.demographics.includes(cb.value));
            } else {
                 demoCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = currentDemos.includes(cb.value));

                localStorage.setItem('preference-seen', 'true');

            // Restore from local

            typeCheckboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = currentTypes.includes(cb.value));

                    b.classList.add('border-slate-700');

                const value = btn.dataset.value;
                selectedValue = value;
                
                btn.classList.add('selected', 'bg-slate-800');
                btn.classList.remove('border-slate-700');
                if (value === 'sfw') {
                    btn.classList.add('border-primary');

                    btn.classList.add('border-red-500');

                         hideModal();

                     }

                     console.error('Error saving preference to DB:', e);

                     checkFormValidity();
                     return;
                 }

             localStorage.setItem('content-types', JSON.stringify(selectedTypes));
             localStorage.setItem('content-demographics', JSON.stringify(selectedDemos));
             localStorage.setItem('preference-seen', 'true');
             window.location.reload();
        });

data-astro-cid-g3jpqmqh>timer</span><span id="top-readers-winner-countdown-text" data-astro-cid-g3jpqmqh>--:--:--</span></span></div></div></aside><script>
(function () {
    const TAB_ON  = ['bg-white', 'dark:bg-slate-800', 'text-slate-900', 'dark:text-white', 'shadow-xs', 'border', 'border-slate-200/60', 'dark:border-slate-700/60'];
    const TAB_OFF = ['text-slate-500', 'dark:text-slate-400', 'hover:text-slate-900', 'dark:hover:text-white'];
    const PERIOD_LABEL = { day: 'HOY', week: 'SEMANA', month: 'MES', streak: 'RACHA' };

    const TOP3 = {
        1: { row: 'bg-amber-500/5 dark:bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-400/30 dark:border-amber-500/30', ring: 'ring-2 ring-amber-400/60', stat: 'bg-amber-500/10 dark:bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400', icon: 'text-amber-500', label: '🥇' },
        2: { row: 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/40 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700/50', ring: 'ring-2 ring-slate-300 dark:ring-slate-600', stat: 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300', icon: 'text-slate-400', label: '🥈' },
        3: { row: 'bg-amber-700/5 dark:bg-amber-700/10 border border-amber-700/20 dark:border-amber-700/30', ring: 'ring-2 ring-amber-700/50', stat: 'bg-amber-700/10 dark:bg-amber-700/20 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400', icon: 'text-amber-600', label: '🥉' },
    };

    const memCache = {};
    let loading        = false;
    let lastFetchedAt  = 0;
    let initialized    = false;
    let countdownInterval = null;
    let nextRefreshTime   = null;
    let currentPeriod     = 'day';
    let endOfPeriodMs     = 0;

    const countdownEl   = document.getElementById('top-readers-countdown-text');
    const winnerCountEl = document.getElementById('top-readers-winner-countdown-text');
    const panel         = document.getElementById('top-readers-panel');
    const overlay       = document.getElementById('top-readers-overlay');
    const skeleton      = document.getElementById('top-readers-skeleton');
    const itemsEl       = document.getElementById('top-readers-items');
    const emptyEl       = document.getElementById('top-readers-empty');
    const subtitle      = document.getElementById('top-readers-subtitle');
    const tabs          = document.querySelectorAll('.top-readers-tab');

    function formatTime(s) {
        const h = Math.floor(s / 3600), m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60);
        return h > 0 ? (m > 0 ? `${h}h ${m}m` : `${h}h`) : `${m}min`;
    }

    function updateWinnerCountdownUI() {
        if (!winnerCountEl || !endOfPeriodMs) return;
        const diff = Math.max(0, Math.floor((endOfPeriodMs - Date.now()) / 1000));
        if (diff > 0) {
            const d = Math.floor(diff / 86400), h = Math.floor((diff % 86400) / 3600),
                  m = Math.floor((diff % 3600) / 60), s = diff % 60;
            winnerCountEl.textContent = (d > 0 ? `${d}d ` : '') + `${h}h ${m}m ${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}s`;
        } else {
            winnerCountEl.textContent = 'Calculando...';
            if (endOfPeriodMs < Date.now() - 2000) calculateEndOfPeriodMX(currentPeriod);
        }
    }

    function calculateEndOfPeriodMX(period) {
        try {
            const mxDate = new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/Mexico_City' }));
            const end = new Date(mxDate);
            if (period === 'day' || period === 'streak') {
                end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
            } else if (period === 'week') {
                const d = end.getDay();
                end.setDate(end.getDate() + (d === 0 ? 0 : 7 - d));
                end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
            } else if (period === 'month') {
                end.setMonth(end.getMonth() + 1);
                end.setDate(0);
                end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
            }
            endOfPeriodMs = Date.now() + (end - mxDate);
            updateWinnerCountdownUI();
        } catch(e) { endOfPeriodMs = 0; }
    }

    function initLocalRefreshCountdown() {
        const now = new Date();
        const nextHour = new Date(now);
        nextHour.setHours(now.getHours() + 1, 0, 0, 0);
        nextRefreshTime = nextHour.getTime();
        startCountdown();
    }

    function renderList(data, period) {
        itemsEl.innerHTML = data.map(r => {
            const isTop3    = r.rank <= 3;
            const t3        = TOP3[r.rank];
            const rowCls    = isTop3 ? t3.row : 'border border-transparent hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40';
            const rankEl    = isTop3
                ? `<span class="text-base leading-none w-7 text-center shrink-0">${t3.label}</span>`
                : `<span class="w-7 text-center text-xs font-bold shrink-0 ${r.rank <= 10 ? 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300' : 'text-slate-400'}">${r.rank}</span>`;
            const ringCls   = isTop3 ? t3.ring : '';
            const isStreak  = r.isStreak || period === 'streak';
            const statIcon  = isTop3 ? t3.icon : (isStreak ? 'text-orange-500' : 'text-slate-400');
            const statVal   = isStreak ? `${r.totalSeconds} días` : formatTime(r.totalSeconds);
            const iconName  = isStreak ? 'local_fire_department' : 'schedule';
            const avatar    = r.avatar || `https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=${encodeURIComponent(r.displayName)}&background=random&size=64`;
            const flag      = r.country ? `<img src="https://s1.cdnlxd.xyz/flags/${r.country.toLowerCase()}.png" alt="${r.country}" class="w-4 h-3 rounded-xs object-contain shadow-xs absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 border border-white dark:border-slate-900" />` : '';
            const frameHtml = r.equippedFrameUrl ? `<img src="${r.equippedFrameUrl}" class="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[130%] h-[130%] max-w-none pointer-events-none z-10 scale-[1.02]" alt="Marco" />` : '';
            const avatarHtml = `<img src="${avatar}" alt="${r.displayName}" class="w-full h-full object-cover shadow-xs rounded-full ${ringCls} group-hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800" loading="lazy" />`;
            const slug = r.profileSlug || r.username;
            return `<li class="flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl transition-colors duration-150 ${rowCls}">
                ${rankEl}
                <a href="/u/${slug}" data-user-id="${r.userId}" rel="nofollow" class="user-profile-trigger relative shrink-0 w-9 h-9 rounded-full block group cursor-pointer my-0.5">
                    ${frameHtml}${avatarHtml}${flag}
                </a>
                <a href="/u/${slug}" data-user-id="${r.userId}" rel="nofollow" class="user-profile-trigger cursor-pointer flex-1 min-w-0 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate hover:text-primary dark:hover:text-primary transition-colors">${r.displayName}</a>
                <span class="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold shrink-0 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg ${isTop3 ? t3.stat : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400'}">
                    <span class="material-icons-outlined text-xs ${statIcon}">${iconName}</span>
                    ${statVal}
                </span>
            </li>`;
        }).join('');
        itemsEl.dataset.renderedPeriod = period;
    }

    function startCountdown() {
        if (countdownInterval) clearInterval(countdownInterval);
        countdownInterval = setInterval(() => {
            if (!nextRefreshTime) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            const remaining = nextRefreshTime - now;
            if (remaining <= 0) {
                if (now - lastFetchedAt < 30000) {
                    if (countdownEl) countdownEl.textContent = 'Actualizando...';
                    return;
                }
                delete memCache[currentPeriod];
                loadData(currentPeriod);
                return;
            }
            const m = Math.floor(remaining / 60000);
            const s = Math.floor((remaining % 60000) / 1000);
            if (countdownEl) countdownEl.textContent = `Faltan ${m}m ${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}s`;
            updateWinnerCountdownUI();
        }, 1000);
    }

    async function loadData(period, forceRefresh = false) {
        if (loading) return;
        const cached = memCache[period];
        if (cached && !forceRefresh && Date.now() < cached.nextRefreshAt) {
            skeleton.classList.add('hidden');
            if (itemsEl.dataset.renderedPeriod !== period) renderList(cached.data, period);
            itemsEl.classList.remove('hidden');
            if (period !== currentPeriod) {
                currentPeriod   = period;
                nextRefreshTime = cached.nextRefreshAt;
                startCountdown();
            }
            return;
        }
        loading = true;
        lastFetchedAt = Date.now();
        skeleton.classList.remove('hidden');
        itemsEl.classList.add('hidden');
        emptyEl.classList.add('hidden');
        try {
            const res  = await fetch(`/api/user/top-readers?period=${period}&limit=30`);
            const json = await res.json();
            const data = json.data ?? [];
            const serverCachedAt = json.cachedAt ?? Date.now();
            const nextRefreshAt  = json.nextRefreshAt ?? (serverCachedAt + 3600000);
            memCache[period]  = { data, ts: serverCachedAt, nextRefreshAt };
            skeleton.classList.add('hidden');
            currentPeriod   = period;
            nextRefreshTime = nextRefreshAt;
            startCountdown();
            if (!data.length) { itemsEl.dataset.renderedPeriod = ''; emptyEl.classList.remove('hidden'); return; }
            renderList(data, period);
            itemsEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        } catch(e) {
            skeleton.classList.add('hidden');
            emptyEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        } finally {
            loading = false;
        }
    }

    async function prefetchSilently(period) {
        if (memCache[period] && Date.now() < memCache[period].nextRefreshAt) return;
        if (loading) return;
        loading = true;
        lastFetchedAt = Date.now();
        try {
            const res = await fetch(`/api/user/top-readers?period=${period}&limit=30`);
            if (!res.ok) return;
            const json = await res.json();
            const data = json.data ?? [];
            const serverCachedAt = json.cachedAt ?? Date.now();
            const nextRefreshAt  = json.nextRefreshAt ?? (serverCachedAt + 3600000);
            memCache[period]  = { data, ts: serverCachedAt, nextRefreshAt };
            nextRefreshTime   = nextRefreshAt;
        } catch(e) {
        } finally {
            loading = false;
        }
    }

    function setTab(period) {
        currentPeriod = period;
        calculateEndOfPeriodMX(period === 'streak' ? 'day' : period);
        const labelMap = { day: 'Cierre Diario', week: 'Cierre Semanal', month: 'Cierre Mensual', streak: 'Cierre de Rachas' };
        const labelEl  = document.getElementById('top-readers-countdown-label');
        if (labelEl) labelEl.textContent = labelMap[period] || 'Cierre Diario';
        tabs.forEach(btn => {
            const on = btn.dataset.period === period;
            TAB_ON.forEach(c  => btn.classList.toggle(c, on));
            TAB_OFF.forEach(c => btn.classList.toggle(c, !on));
        });
        if (subtitle) subtitle.textContent = `Top 30 Lectores · ${PERIOD_LABEL[period] ?? period}`;
        loadData(period);
    }

    tabs.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => setTab(btn.dataset.period)));

    window.openTopReaders = function () {
        const socialButtons = document.getElementById('global-social-buttons');
        if (socialButtons) { socialButtons.style.opacity = '0'; socialButtons.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; }
        overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            overlay.classList.remove('opacity-0');
            panel.classList.remove('translate-x-full');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        });
        if (!initialized) { initialized = true; setTab(currentPeriod); }
    };

    window.closeTopReaders = function () {
        overlay.classList.add('opacity-0');
        panel.classList.add('translate-x-full');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        setTimeout(() => {
            overlay.classList.add('hidden');
            const socialButtons = document.getElementById('global-social-buttons');
            if (socialButtons) { socialButtons.style.opacity = ''; socialButtons.style.pointerEvents = ''; }
        }, 300);
    };

    calculateEndOfPeriodMX('day');
    initLocalRefreshCountdown();

    const schedulePrefetch = () => prefetchSilently('day');
    if (typeof requestIdleCallback !== 'undefined') {
        requestIdleCallback(schedulePrefetch, { timeout: 3000 });
    } else {
        setTimeout(schedulePrefetch, 2000);
    }
})();

id="top-mangas-countdown-text" data-astro-cid-wp5ecqwe>--:--</span></span></div></div></aside><script>
(function () {
    const TAB_ON  = ['bg-white', 'dark:bg-slate-700', 'text-slate-900', 'dark:text-white', 'shadow-sm'];
    const TAB_OFF = ['text-slate-500', 'dark:text-slate-400', 'hover:bg-white/60', 'dark:hover:bg-slate-700/50'];
    const PERIOD_LABEL = { day: 'HOY', week: 'SEMANA', month: 'MES' };

    const TOP3 = {
        1: {
            row: 'bg-amber-50/80 dark:bg-amber-500/5 border-amber-200/60 dark:border-amber-500/15 hover:bg-amber-100/80 dark:hover:bg-amber-500/10',
            rank: 'bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400',
        },
        2: {
            row: 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/50 border-slate-200/70 dark:border-slate-700/40 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800',
            rank: 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300',
        },
        3: {
            row: 'bg-orange-50/70 dark:bg-orange-500/5 border-orange-200/50 dark:border-orange-500/15 hover:bg-orange-100/70 dark:hover:bg-orange-500/10',
            rank: 'bg-orange-100 dark:bg-orange-500/15 text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-400',
        },
    };

    const compactNumber = new Intl.NumberFormat('es-CL', { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1 });

    const memCache = {};
    let requestVersion = 0;
    let pendingPeriod = null;
    let lastFetchedAt = 0;
    let initialized = false;
    let countdownInterval = null;
    let nextRefreshTime = null; 
    let currentPeriod = 'day';

    const countdownEl = document.getElementById('top-mangas-countdown-text');
    const panel    = document.getElementById('top-mangas-panel');
    const overlay  = document.getElementById('top-mangas-overlay');
    const skeleton = document.getElementById('top-mangas-skeleton');
    const itemsEl  = document.getElementById('top-mangas-items');
    const emptyEl  = document.getElementById('top-mangas-empty');
    const subtitle = document.getElementById('top-mangas-subtitle');
    const tabs     = document.querySelectorAll('.top-mangas-tab');

    function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&', '<':'<', '>':'>', '"':'"', "'":'''}[c]));
    }
    function countValue(value) {
        return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 0 ? value : null;
    }
    function communityStat(value, label, icon, color, description) {
        const count = countValue(value);
        const number = count === null ? '—' : count.toLocaleString('es-CL');
        const displayNumber = count !== null && count >= 10000 ? compactNumber.format(count) : number;
        const accessibleLabel = count === null ? `${label}: dato no disponible` : `${number} ${description}`;
        return `<span class="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1" title="${accessibleLabel}" aria-label="${accessibleLabel}">
            <span class="material-icons-outlined top-mangas-small-icon shrink-0 ${color}" aria-hidden="true">${icon}</span>
            <span class="truncate text-[11px] leading-4 font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">${displayNumber}</span>
            <span class="sr-only">${label}</span>
        </span>`;
    }


    function renderList(data, period) {
        itemsEl.innerHTML = data.map(r => {
            const isTop3 = r.rank >= 1 && r.rank <= 3;
            const t3     = TOP3[r.rank];

            const rowCls  = isTop3
                ? t3.row
                : 'border-transparent hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60';
            const rankCls = isTop3 ? t3.rank : 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500';
            const rankEl = `<span class="flex h-6 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-[11px] font-extrabold tabular-nums shrink-0 ${rankCls}" aria-label="Puesto ${escapeHtml(r.rank)}">${escapeHtml(String(r.rank).padStart(2, '0'))}</span>`;

            const safeSlug = escapeHtml(r.slug);
            const safeTitle = escapeHtml(r.title);
            const safeCover = escapeHtml(r.coverImage);
            return `<li><button type="button"
                class="group flex items-center gap-2.5 w-full text-left px-2.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border transition-colors duration-150 cursor-pointer focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-orange-400 ${rowCls}"
                data-slug="${safeSlug}"
                data-title="${safeTitle}"
                data-cover="${safeCover}"
                data-reading="${countValue(r.readingCount) ?? ''}"
                data-planned="${countValue(r.plannedCount) ?? ''}"
                data-completed="${countValue(r.completedCount) ?? ''}"
                data-rank="${escapeHtml(r.rank)}"
            >
                ${rankEl}
                <span class="top-mangas-cover" aria-hidden="true">
                    ${safeCover ? `<img src="${safeCover}" alt="" width="52" height="74" loading="lazy" decoding="async" onerror="this.hidden = true" />` : ''}
                </span>
                <span class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <span class="block text-[13px] font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 line-clamp-2 leading-4.5 wrap-anywhere" title="${safeTitle}">${safeTitle}</span>
                    <span class="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-4">
                        ${communityStat(r.readingCount, 'Leyendo', 'menu_book', 'text-orange-500 dark:text-orange-400', 'personas leyendo')}
                        ${communityStat(r.plannedCount, 'Por leer', 'bookmark_add', 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400', 'personas lo tienen por leer')}
                    </span>
                </span>
                <span class="material-icons-outlined top-mangas-chevron shrink-0 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 group-hover:text-orange-500" aria-hidden="true">chevron_right</span>
            </button></li>`;
        }).join('');
        itemsEl.dataset.renderedPeriod = period;
    }

    function startCountdown() {
        if (countdownInterval) clearInterval(countdownInterval);
        countdownInterval = setInterval(() => {
            if (!nextRefreshTime) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            const remaining = nextRefreshTime - now;

            if (remaining <= 0) {
                const timeSinceLastFetch = now - lastFetchedAt;
                if (timeSinceLastFetch < 30000) {
                    if (countdownEl) countdownEl.textContent = 'Actualizando...';
                    return; 
                }

                delete memCache[currentPeriod];
                loadData(currentPeriod);
                return;
            }
            const totalSeconds = Math.floor(remaining / 1000);
            const m = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);
            const s = totalSeconds % 60;
            if (countdownEl) countdownEl.textContent = `Faltan ${m}m ${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}s`;
        }, 1000);
    }

    async function loadData(period, forceRefresh = false) {
        if (pendingPeriod === period) return;
        const version = ++requestVersion;
        pendingPeriod = null;

        const cached = memCache[period];
        if (cached && !forceRefresh && (Date.now() < cached.nextRefreshAt)) {
            skeleton.classList.add('hidden');
            if (itemsEl.dataset.renderedPeriod !== period) {
                renderList(cached.data, period);
            }
            itemsEl.classList.remove('hidden');
            emptyEl.classList.toggle('hidden', cached.data.length > 0);
            nextRefreshTime = cached.nextRefreshAt;
            startCountdown();
            return;
        }

        pendingPeriod = period;
        lastFetchedAt = Date.now();
        skeleton.classList.remove('hidden');
        itemsEl.classList.add('hidden');
        emptyEl.classList.add('hidden');
